title: "M04_4_Fratrie"
format: html
---

```{r setup}
#| message: FALSE
#| echo: False

library(tidyverse)
library(questionr)
```

```{r}

M1_A3 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M1_A3.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)

F4_A0 <- haven::read_sas("../../data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_fa_04_fratrie_04.sas7bdat")

M4_C2_bornes0 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M4_C2_bornes0.csv",
                                show_col_types = F)

```

# Corriger données d'identité

```{r}

# Ajouter id_doublon
F4_A1 <- F4_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    pf_fratrie_prenom = str_to_upper(pf_fratrie_prenom),
    pf_fratrie_prenom = replace_when(
      pf_fratrie_prenom,
      pf_fratrie_prenom == "NA" ~ "NAA"
    )
  )

# Remplir les données manquantes de l'identité

F4_A2 <- F4_A1 %>% 
  rows_patch(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(any_of(colnames(F4_A1))),
    by = "id_anonymat",
    unmatched = "ignore"
  ) %>% 
  select(-(fa_type:fa_fratrie_cat), -fratrie_type)


```

# Garder les colonnes du module

```{r}

F4_B0 <- F4_A2 %>% 
  relocate(
    c("id_date_nais", "id_sexe", "fratrie_date_creation", "fratrie_pf_fratrie", "pf_fratrie",
      "pf_fratrie_prenom", "pf_fratrie_sexe", "pf_fratrie_mois_nais", "pf_fratrie_an_nais",
      "pf_frsr_issu", "pf_frsr_mois_adopte", "pf_frsr_an_adopte", "pf_fratrie_diag_avt_nais",
      "pf_fratrie_muco", "pf_fratrie_decede", "pf_fratrie_mois_deces", "pf_fratrie_an_deces",
      "commentaires_fam"), 
    .after = id_keep) %>% 
  select(-(id_date_creation:sf_raison_muco))

rm(list = c("F4_A0", "F4_A1", "F4_A2"))

```

# Identifier les absents

```{r}

vars_check <- F4_B0 %>%
  select(pf_fratrie_prenom:pf_fratrie_an_deces) %>%
  colnames()

F4_B1 <- F4_B0 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    fr_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent) %>% 
  relocate(fr_complet, .after = fratrie_date_creation)

rm(list = c("vars_check", "F4_B0"))
```

# Retirer les doublons

```{r}

# Identifier les doublons
doublons_1 <- F4_B1 %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  filter(any(id_anonymat == id_doublon)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  
  arrange(id_keep, pf_fratrie_an_nais) 
  

# Garder que les lignes différentes ------------------------------------------------
  
doublons_2 <- doublons_1 %>% 
  filter(fr_complet == 1) %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  
  # Retirer les lignes pareilles
  distinct(
    pick(pf_fratrie_prenom:pf_fratrie_an_deces),
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>% 
  
  # Trouver ceux qui ont plus d'une ligne pour une meme personne
  group_by(id_keep, pf_fratrie_prenom, pf_fratrie_sexe, pf_frsr_issu) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_sibling = cur_group_id()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Trier parmis ceux qui ont renseigné plus d'une fois une meme relation --------

doublons_3 <- doublons_2 %>%
  group_by(id_sibling) %>% 
  filter(n() > 1) %>% 
  arrange(id_keep, id_sibling) %>% 
  ungroup()

doublons_4 <- doublons_3 %>% 
  filter_out(is.na(pf_fratrie_an_nais)) %>% 
  group_by(id_sibling) %>% 
  filter(fratrie_date_creation == min(fratrie_date_creation)) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Réunir les doublons ----------------------------------------------------------
doublons_5 <- doublons_2 %>% 
  
  # Retirer ceux qu'on a modifiés
  filter_out(id_sibling %in% doublons_3$id_sibling) %>% 
  bind_rows(doublons_4) %>% 
  select(-id_sibling)


# Corriger id_anonymat des doublons --------------------------------------------

doublons_corr <- doublons_5 %>%  
  mutate(
    id_anonymat = id_keep
  )

# Joindre les données propres
F4_C0 <- F4_B1 %>% 
  filter_out(id_keep %in% doublons_1$id_keep) %>% 
  bind_rows(doublons_corr) %>% 
  arrange(id_anonymat, pf_fratrie_an_nais, pf_fratrie_mois_nais)

rm(list = c("doublons_1", "doublons_2", "doublons_3", "doublons_4", "doublons_5",
            "doublons_corr"))


```
